ai.notes: The Group-wide access-to-hearing-care program target for 2025/26 was not achieved and was extended to 2026/27, so it is planned and not scored. Divestment of the Consumer Hearing business was announced in March 2026 and is not yet complete. Cross-cultural was torn between 3 and 4: the core business is assistive hearing technology for people with a disability, which the report frames as social inclusion and says reached 17 million lives improved. It was scored at the lower level because it is primarily a medical-device business, so a human may want to check this. Not counted: the Sara Mearns ballerina story (brand storytelling trap), LinkedIn Learning 'creative capabilities' courses (employee training), and Sonova Academy training of over 5,000 HCPs on new products (partly customer product education; that quote also spans a page break). China training of more than 500 local HCPs was not recorded because it is unclear whether trainees are external. Workforce is described as 'more than 19,000 employees' (headcount 19,604) versus 18,447 FTE. No red flags found: the social audit found no discrimination, child labor or forced labor issues, and no SpeakUp case counts are disclosed.
